name: Quick AI — Fact Check & Ask AI on Any Page
//short_name: What Chrome shows where the full title will not fit: the toolbar tooltip, chrome://extensions, the app menu. The long name is for STORE SEARCH, which is keyword-driven; short_name keeps the product from looking like a spam listing everywhere else.
description: Highlight any text, tap Shift, and get a straight answer with its sources — without leaving the page.
//permissions: identity is for the OPTIONAL Google sign-in, via launchWebAuthFlow. It grants no access to any Google data on its own — it opens a window and hands back what the user consented to, which here is only their email address.
//host_permissions: Only the service is contacted now. google.serper.dev and api.deepinfra.com were removed in v0.18.0 with the own-keys path: the extension no longer calls either, and every host listed here that the code never contacts is a question to answer in Web Store review.
